name: StandardsMasteryTracker
tagline: Standards-based grading heat grid with evidence, trends, reteach and support flags.
description: A PCF control for teachers and instructional leaders: every student against every standard, mastery calculated from evidence with six methods, insufficient-evidence rules, evidence history with charts, add evidence and teacher overrides, plus class-level reteach and needs-support analysis. Works in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Students x standards heat grid with strand bands and priority standards
Six mastery calculation methods incl. decaying average
Evidence history with score chart and method comparison
Add evidence and teacher overrides with reasons
Phone layout with heat strips and bottom sheet
Keyboard grid navigation and ARIA labels
